verdict.rationale: Jira documents syncing with Trello (another project management tool) and points to 3,000+ Marketplace integrations. It also claims Rovo AI connects data from third-party apps to your work. None of this evidence shows a native unified view of one engineer's assigned tasks pulled from several PM tools. Missing for 10: an explicit cross-tool 'my assigned tasks' aggregate view, documented support for PM tools beyond Trello (e.g., Asana, Linear), and hands-on or independent corroboration.
